# algolia_dictionary_entry (Resource)

Manages a single custom entry in an Algolia dictionary (stopwords, plurals, or compounds). Dictionaries are application-level: entries are not scoped to a specific index.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algolia_dictionary_entry" "stopword" {
  dictionary = "stopwords"
  language   = "en"
  word       = "the"
}

resource "algolia_dictionary_entry" "plural" {
  dictionary = "plurals"
  language   = "fr"
  words      = ["cheval", "chevaux"]
}

resource "algolia_dictionary_entry" "compound" {
  dictionary    = "compounds"
  language      = "de"
  word          = "kopfschmerzen"
  decomposition = ["kopf", "schmerzen"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dictionary` (String) Dictionary the entry belongs to. One of "stopwords", "plurals", or "compounds".
- `language` (String) ISO code of the language the entry applies to, for example "en" or "fr".

### Optional

- `decomposition` (List of String) Individual components of a compound word. Required for "compounds" entries.
- `object_id` (String) Unique identifier of the dictionary entry. Generated automatically if omitted.
- `state` (String) Whether the entry is active. One of "enabled" or "disabled". Applies to "stopwords" entries; defaults to "enabled".
- `word` (String) Matching dictionary word. Required for "stopwords" and "compounds" entries.
- `words` (List of String) Matching word forms, including declensions. Required for "plurals" entries.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in the form <dictionary>/<object_id>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import a dictionary entry using the form "dictionary/object_id".
# dictionary is one of: stopwords, plurals, compounds.
terraform import algolia_dictionary_entry.stopword stopwords/my-stopword
```
